ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Mfdetours.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "mfdetours.dll". While using "mftrace.exe" it can be abused to attach to an arbitrary process and force load any DLL named "mfdetours.dll" from the current directory of execution. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\mfdetours\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Windows\\ Kits\\\\10\\\\bin\\\\.*"))
